race.description: It's Ok Not To Be Ok Hcp (C1)
race.comment: ANGEL HAIR (2) stalked the leader then went home too well last start over this course and distance to bring up his maiden win at just the second attempt. Capable of taking this next step with plenty of natural improvement to come. MISS SCANDAL (5) showed pace but knocked up when resuming over this distance at Warwick Farm recently. Big drop in grade today and will tighten right up after that last outing so expect far more resilience. SCURO STAR (8) returns after a four-month break. Raced just twice to date, both over 1100m, and shows plenty of promise. Can win if forward enough. TURF LUCK (12) resumed with an effortless win over 1000m at Canberra last start. Faces a much deeper race this time but cannot be underestimated.
